entities.summary: Ubaldina Valoyes Cuesta is a female weightlifter from Colombia. She won a gold medal at the 2007 Pan American Games for her native South American country. Valoyes has represented Colombia at the Summer Olympics three times: in 2004, 2008 and 2012. She won the – 75 kg gold medal in snatch and clean & jerk during the 2014 Pan American Sports Festival. Ubaldina Valoyes was a athletes & competitors from Quibdó (b. 1982-07-06, Quibdó). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
